notes: Identity verified from supplied canonical text: title Symmetrical interaction of sex and expression in face classification tasks; Luis Aguado, Ana García-Gutierrez and Ignacio Serrano-Pedraza; 2009, 71(1), 9–25; doi:10.3758/APP.71.1.9. Primary research article text with methods, results, references and appendices. No PDF supplied. Canonical parse contains corrupted mathematical symbols and omits p inequality operators. Error-rate target identified by outcome and p. 12: expression-task errors were not analyzed further; sex-task interaction prints partial eta-squared .64 and F(1,15) 27.11. Same-test p token is .001, but the supplied canonical text prints "p .001" with no inequality/equality operator; no bound reconstructed. N candidate: 32 total allocated half to each task would imply 32 / 2 = 16 assigned participants in the sex condition; this is not an explicitly reported final analytic count, and N is not derived from df. The 32 faces and pilot sample of 30 are distinct roles and are excluded from participant N. Replication and reported_success are unassigned placeholders.
